notes: Main SERL configuration: Agent (policy) Qwen3-4B with LoRA, Doctor google/gemma-3-12b-it, max 7 turns with early stopping, dataset agentclinic_main_v2. The Effectiveness predictor is a separate Qwen3-8B + LoRA + scalar head trained on this environment's labels; until it exists R_E is unavailable at every turn and GRPO with w_E > 0 does not start. Rubric method: per-iteration regeneration, validation, consolidation, effectiveness-gap filter and weights.
roles_notes: Agent local Qwen3-4B; Doctor google/gemma-3-12b-it (OpenRouter); outcome judge openai/gpt-4o-mini; Effectiveness predictor backbone Qwen3-8B; Sol = openai/gpt-6.1-sol (candidate generation, failure analysis, consolidation); Jev = typesafe/jev-1.13 (rubric scoring, candidate compliance).

devices.notes: The policy is Qwen3-4B (about 8 GB in bf16, more while training) and the Effectiveness predictor is Qwen3-8B + LoRA (about 16 GB). Whether the two fit on one 24 GB GPU has not been measured; the configuration keeps them as two processes on two GPUs (placement concurrent) for GRPO with w_E > 0.

effectiveness.notes: No Effectiveness predictor exists for this environment yet. It will be ONE turn-conditioned predictor (Qwen3-8B + LoRA + scalar head, intervention turn A1 ... A7) trained on this environment's labels at every reached turn (scripts/train_max7.py: TRAIN case-level CV, calibration chosen on TRAIN out-of-fold logits between identity and one global temperature, DEV evaluated once, offline/gRPC parity). The predictor then serves every turn A1 ... A7; there is no per-turn gate, and turns with little support are reported as such. Until then R_E is unavailable at every turn (never 0), the other weights are not rescaled, and GRPO with w_E > 0 does not start. scripts/train_max7.py parity fills this section in after parity passes.

role_models.status: Connected: Sol = openai/gpt-6.1-sol (candidate generator, failure analyzer, rubric manager), Jev = typesafe/jev-1.13 through OpenRouter's Decisions API (rubric scorer, compliance judge). Both verified with fixture calls on 2026-10-02. The pinned ids are used, not the latest aliases.

decision_outputs.rubric_scorer: per rubric: applicable / No Match, score 0 | 1 | 2, confidence / probabilities
decision_outputs.notes: Sol generates (candidates, failure analysis, rubrics, consolidation); Jev makes bounded decisions (scores, compliance). A written reason is not part of a decision and no model writes one for Jev's decision afterwards. The scorer's input, the rubric, the decision and its probabilities are stored with every score (reward_log.jsonl, gap_scores.jsonl) and with every candidate judgment, so that a stratified sample can be audited by a human or an independent model (scripts/scorer_audit_sample.py).

scorer.name: jev
scorer.notes: Rubric scorer: Jev 1.13 through OpenRouter's Decisions API. One choice per rubric (NA / 0 / 1 / 2) with a probability for every option; no text. The scorer's input, the rubric and the decision with its probabilities are stored with every score. At most max_rubrics_per_call rubrics per call (Jev's context is 32K tokens). rubrics.prompt and prompt_addendum belong to the chat scorer and are not used by this backend.
